lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-row grid formation, with at least four distinct horizontal layers visible along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, creating a structured grid pattern where the blobs act as nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity pixels on the superior edge and a low-intensity shadow immediately inferior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 8-10 discrete, high-luminance blobs distributed across its lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance points that are significantly reduced in diameter compared to the primary flank blobs.
